jealousy.linePrev: We'd roll and fall in green
jealousy.line: You had a temper like my jealousy
stanza: Out on the wily, windy moors
We'd roll and fall in green
You had a temper like my jealousy
When I needed to possess you?
I hated you, I loved you too

jealousy.lineNext: I watch her talking to some old friend
stanza: I watch her talking to some old friend
What a reunion, he recognised her across the room
How many years could there be to catch up on?
And somewhere between drunkenness and honesty
I make a silent toast to the things that I do and don't miss
